stemMarkdown: 18 workers, each working 4 hours a day, can complete a job in 21 days. How many days will 25 workers, each working 5 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 18 \times 21 \times 4$ worker-hours $= 1512$. With 25 workers at 5 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{1512}{25\times5} = 12.10$.
